double-ended-saddle-search/lj38.caption: Success rate on LJ38 double-ended saddle, in rank order. The rate is the share of runs that finished. 8 ranked rows did not record a success rate and are not drawn.

Dolan-Moré profile for Minimum mode on LJ38 double-ended saddle. The curve is the fraction of starts whose cost is at most tau times the best finite cost in this family. Tau is 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16. An unsolved start stays in the denominator and does not cross a finite tau. Dolan, E. D. and Moré, J. J., Math. Program. 91:201-213, 2002.

Force calls on each recorded start for LJ38 double-ended saddle. The box is the quartiles of those counts. A blue point is a success and a vermillion cross is a recorded failure (402). The horizontal position is the recorded count. The vertical offset only keeps marks from covering one another.

eOn on LJ38 double-ended saddle. Each point is one recorded version of one method. Versions run left to right in numeric order. PAR-2 is omitted where that row has none. No line is drawn across a missing value.
